description: Apply transformations to a JSON object: pick specific fields, rename keys, flatten nested objects, or unflatten dot-notation keys.

data.description: The JSON data to transform (as a JSON string)

fields.description: For 'pick': array of field paths to extract (supports dot notation like 'user.name')

mapping.description: For 'rename': object mapping old key names to new key names

name: json_transform
